messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: service=aurora-inference region=eu-west-1 alert=aurora-degrade-v2 — spike in 5xx rate (20% over baseline in 5m). Bridge: https://redwood.inc/bridges/aurora-degrade-1745678901
ash: I'm primary for EU until 21:00 UTC but boarding a flight in ~25m. I can't take the pager while airborne. Need someone to cover primary for ~3.5h. Will hand off before takeoff.
maria: I'm technically on PTO but can be a shadow/secondary if needed, cc @cs for customer notices.
kevin: I can temporarily cover 25-60m if it's just triage; I have a deploy at +2h so can't hold long.
oliver: I can pick up the full 3.5h block. Natalie's nearby for secondary. I'll take primary now if that works.
natalie: happy to be secondary and watch SLOs. Phone on.
ash: Thanks @oliver @natalie. Handoff plan: ash -> oliver primary, natalie secondary. I'll update the rota and then board.
oliver: Taking. First checks: router-level 504s or worker OOMs? Any model-specific hot prefixes?
kevin: Quick logs show router 504s and several worker OOMKills. Likely hot-prefix decode causing mem spikes on workers.
maria: Customer-impact tracker: AcmeHealth, Botify, WriteNow show e2e latency >10s. No wholesale errors yet but UX degraded. CS threshold -> notify at 10% error or latency >15s.
oliver: Opening runbook snippet (essentials):
```
# triage
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/aurora-router | tail -n 200
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=aurora-worker -o wide
# scale workers
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/aurora-worker --replicas=8
# route fallback
redwoodctl route set aurora --variant=quantized-2 --weight=30
```
oliver: Running `get pods` now to check restart counts.
kevin: If restarts >2 across workers, do fallback + scale. Also check KV cache: `redis-cli -h redis-infer info` — look at used_memory_rss and evictions.
oliver: Results: 5/6 worker pods show 1-3 restarts, 2 pods OOMKilled in last 10m. CPU ok but memory spikes during decode. Kicking scale to 8 replicas.
ash: We have autoscaler bump scheduled in 2.5h but manual needed now.
oliver: Scaled to 8, pods creating. Applying fallback to quantized-2 @30%.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Route update applied by oliver. quantized-2 weight=30%
kevin: Also bump cache TTL temporarily: `cachectl set ttl 1800` — helps KV reuse on hot prefixes.
oliver: TTL set to 1800s. New pods coming up Ready. Error rate trending down 20% -> 6% over 8m. WriteNow latency from ~12s to ~4s.
natalie: Monitoring SLO dashboard: memory stable, no new OOMs in last 6m. Error percentages in warn band.
maria: Noting US holiday window — responses might be slower if we need extra hands. Tagging CS for the three customers.
sanjay: On APAC shift; can shadow for 30m starting in ~2h if needed.
oliver: Short post-incident note draft:
- cause: worker OOMs during hot-prefix surge
- mitigations: manual scale -> 8 replicas; route fallback to quantized-2 @30%; cache TTL -> 1800s
- affected customers: AcmeHealth, Botify, WriteNow (latency spikes / partial errors)
- follow-ups: autoscaler policy tuned for decode-heavy prefixes; increase worker memory in next infra rollout
natalie: I'll create the incident ticket and loop in CS/AMs for customer comms.
ash: Boarding now — handing off primary to oliver. Bridge live, alert acknowledged. Leaving Slack as primary notification in my calendar. Thanks all.
oliver: Acknowledged. I'll hold the bridge and escalate to natalie if I need a break. I'll post a 1-line handoff when I drop.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Alert acknowledged by oliver. Incident status: mitigated (trend improving).
